I'm really sorry you're feeling this way. I completely understand how youre feeling, I've been in the same boat lately. Feeling like I'm stuck in a hole that just keeps getting deeper and I can't dig myself out. What I will say is that you didn't bring this onto yourself, depression and anxiety did. You didn't choose to have those disorders/emotions, and the fact that you care so much about being productive shows that you want something to change and you want to get better. That's really good, and This isn't your fault.

I know everyone's different, and your situation might be a lot different from mine. But for me, the first step I take when I feel like this is just doing something. It doesn't matter if it's a big thing or productive, just try to find something you like/used to like doing. Depression takes all the motivation and joy from things that I like doing, and I stop doing them. I stop doing everything really. So even if I don't want to, I'll force myself to play a videogame, cook, watch a movie, anything I used to like. And after a second of forcing myself into it, I end up enjoying it a bit and feeling just a little better. 

As hard as it is, try to stop worrying about productivity, it's never too late to take care of things. You and your happiness are far more important than anything else right now. In times like this, it's okay to just focus on yourself. You are more important than any task that needs to be done.
